authority: Human Director ratification required. Not law until ratified.

button_families.constraint: never two purple primaries in one area
button_families.face: top bright electric amethyst -> center royal saturated purple -> bottom deep violet
button_families.name: royal-purple-primary
white-utility
button_families.role: sparing, only when contrast demands it

elite_definition: An interface is elite when people instantly understand what it is, what to press, and what happens next.
enforcement_followups: CI check asserting six-layer structure on premium controls
CI check asserting five-state CSS coverage per button
CI check asserting no generic flat buttons on primary actions
extends: HUB/DESIGN-CONTRACT.md (Button Law, Living Depth Law, Spectrum Law)

active.rule: brighter border plus icon change / filled icon / indicator; never color alone

disabled.rule: reduced contrast, no glow, no lift, clearly inactive

glow_discipline.rule: tight at edge, softer secondary aura, focal sparkle at corners; no neon haze; gold is rare luxury reflection, never dominant; glow color semantically tied, never random

locked_rule.statement: No important action may use a generic flat browser-style button. Every future major action uses a Black Diamond Royal family.

name: Black Diamond Royal Interface System

palette_reconciliation.standing_color_standard_resolution: black canvas wins; HMC hexes are the canonical values within the 2026-10-04 standing color standard

purple_face_exception.conflict: Standing color standard says purple = accent/glow only, never solid fill; Royal Purple Primary has a purple gradient face.
purple_face_exception.proposed_reconciliation: Family A is a gradient, never a flat fill; reserved for the single strongest action per area; purple remains accent/glow everywhere else.

shape_language.compact_controls: perfect circle, consistent diameter within a row

required_layers.description: Deep base surface: black glass, royal purple glass, or diamond white
Metallic outer frame: platinum, or controlled gold-platinum edging
Inner illuminated rim: purple or white energy line inside the border
Raised face: bevel or soft vertical gradient for physical depth
Directional highlight: brighter reflection near the top edge
Floating shadow + aura: dark drop shadow plus restrained purple glow

source: HMC batch-1 distillation (HMC Button Spec + HMC Standard PDFs), 2026-10-06

spacing.rule: equal heights per row; no icons touching borders

touch_target.rule: every interactive control must have a touch target of 44-48px
